Class WeakLinkedHashSet<E>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractSet<E>
org.wpilib.util.container.WeakLinkedHashSet<E>
Type Parameters:
E - The type of elements in the set.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<E>, Collection<E>, SequencedCollection<E>, SequencedSet<E>, Set<E>
public final class WeakLinkedHashSet<E> extends AbstractSet<E> implements SequencedSet<E>
A variant of LinkedHashSet with weak references to entries. This container will not prevent its entries from being garbage collected, unlike a typical Set. Null elements are not permitted; calling add(null) will always throw a NullPointerException.

  • Constructor Details

    • WeakLinkedHashSet

      public WeakLinkedHashSet()
      Constructs a new, empty linked hash set with the default initial capacity (16) and load factor (0.75).

    • WeakLinkedHashSet

      public WeakLinkedHashSet(Collection<? extends E> collection)
      Constructs a new linked hash set with the same elements as the specified collection. The linked hash set is created with an initial capacity sufficient to hold the elements in the specified collection and the default load factor (0.75).
      Parameters:
      collection - the collection whose elements are to be placed into this set
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the specified collection is null
